030package dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate;
031
032import java.lang.System.Logger;
033import java.util.EnumSet;
034import java.util.Set;
035
036import javax.sql.RowSet;
037
038import dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.RSC;
039import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModelEventHandling.RowsEventSource;
040import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
041
042import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
043import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils.isJunit;
044import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils.objectID;
045import static java.lang.System.Logger.Level.*;
046
047/**
048 * An Event object that bundles events generated through  one or more operations
049 * on a {@link javax.sql.RowSet}.
050 * The event can originate from a {@link RowsAction}, from an
051 * {@link RSC}/{@link dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent}, or
052 * from something else, use {@link #getKindOperator} to determine the kind;
053 * and use {@link #getOperComponent()} or {@link #getOperAct()} for
054 * the specific operator.
055 * The property {@link RowSetEventType} indicates which RowSet events are bundled.
056 * Use the RowsModel to get the RowSet.
057 */
058@SuppressWarnings("serial")
059public class RowsEvent extends EventObjectBacktrace implements RowsModelEvent {
060  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
061
062  /** The type of NaviagionRowSetEvent events */
063  public enum RowSetEventType {
064    /** See {@link javax.sql.RowSetListener#cursorMoved(javax.sql.RowSetEvent) } */
065    CURSOR_MOVED,
066    /** See {@link javax.sql.RowSetListener#rowChanged(javax.sql.RowSetEvent)} */
067    ROW_CHANGED,
068    /** See {@link javax.sql.RowSetListener#rowSetChanged(javax.sql.RowSetEvent)} */
069    ROW_SET_CHANGED,
070  }
071
072  /** The type of RowSet operation which caused this event. */
073  // TODO: originatingComponentType
074  // TODO: KindOperator ???
075  public enum OperatorKind {
076    /** A {@link RowsAction}, typically a button push, generated this event */
077    ACTION,
078    /** An SsComponent's action generated this event, like user input. */
079    COMPONENT,
080    /** Other bracketed event, like SyncManger. */
081    OTHER,
082    /**
083     * Direct RowSet operation; not bracketed.
084     * Alternate SyncManager handling or outside of Seesaw.
085     */
086    ANON,
087    /** Initialization that should never show up in use. */
088    UNKNOWN,
089  }
090
091  private static int generation;
092
093  /** NOTE: rowSetEventTypes may "grow" before dispatch */
094  private final Set<RowSetEventType> rowSetEventTypes;
095  private final int gen;
096
097  /**
098   * An Event object generated for a RowsAction on a RowSet.
099   * @param source
100   * @param rs
101   * @param operatorKind
102   * @param operator Either a RowsAction or RSC/component; may be null
103   * @param rowSetEventTypes
104   */
105  RowsEvent(RowsEventSource source, Set<RowSetEventType> rowSetEventTypes) {
106    super(source);
107    this.rowSetEventTypes = EnumSet.copyOf(rowSetEventTypes);
108    this.gen = ++generation;
109
110    switch (source.operatorKind()) {
111      case COMPONENT -> {
112        if (!(source.operator() instanceof RSC))
113          throw new IllegalArgumentException(sf("%s must have a component"));
114      }
115      case ACTION -> {
116        if (!(source.operator() instanceof RowsAction))
117          throw new IllegalArgumentException(sf("%s must have an action"));
118      }
119      case null, default -> {
120      }
121    }
122  }
123  RowsEvent(RowsEventSource source, RowSetEventType rowSetEventType) {
124    this(source, EnumSet.of(rowSetEventType));
125  }
126
127  boolean absorb(RowsEvent rev) {
128    // UNKNOWN never matches
129    if (getSource().operatorKind() == OperatorKind.UNKNOWN
130        || !getSource().equals(rev.getSource())) {
131      return false;
132    }
133
134    if (isJunit())
135      System.out.println("absorb: " + rev.rowSetEventTypes);
136    else
137      logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("absorb: %s", rev.rowSetEventTypes));
138    rowSetEventTypes.addAll(rev.rowSetEventTypes);
139    return true;
140  }
141
142  // TODO: Other versions of absorb? Or maybe can absorb?
143
144  /** {@inheritDoc } */
145  @Override
146  @SuppressWarnings("NonPublicExported")
147  public final RowsEventSource getSource() {
148    return (RowsEventSource) source;
149  }
150
151  /**
152   * Test if this event is for the specified rowSet.
153   * @param rowSet check against this rowSet
154   * @return true if the event is for the specified rowSet
155   */
156  public boolean matches(RowSet rowSet) {
157    return getSource().rowSet() == rowSet;
158  }
159
160  /**
161   * A RowsModel.
162   * @return RowsModel that issued the event
163   */
164  @Override
165  public RowsModel getRowsModel() {
166    return getSource().rowsModel();
167  }
168
169  /**
170   * Return the RowSet associated with these events.
171   * @return
172   */
173  public RowSet getRowSet() {
174    return getSource().rowSet();
175  }
176
177  /**
178   * The events generated by the navigation action.
179   * @return the events generated by the navigation action.
180   */
181  public Set<RowSetEventType> getEventTypes() {
182    return rowSetEventTypes;
183  }
184
185  /**
186   * The actions on the rowset that generated the events.
187   * Null if the OperatorKind is not a NavAction.
188   *
189   * @return the RowsAction that generated the events.
190   */
191  public RowsAction getOperAct() {
192    if (getSource().operatorKind() != OperatorKind.ACTION)
193      return null;
194    return (RowsAction) getSource().operator();
195  }
196
197  /**
198   * The {@link RSC} that originated the event.
199   * Null if the OperatorKind is not an SsComponent.
200   * @return the component that originated the events
201   */
202  public RSC getOperComponent() {
203    if (getSource().operatorKind() != OperatorKind.COMPONENT)
204      return null;
205    return (RSC) getSource().operator();
206  }
207
208  /**
209   * The operator that originated the event;
210   * use {@link #getKindOperator() } to determine the kind.
211   * This is the operator no matter the OperatorKind.
212   * @return the object that originated the events
213   */
214  public Object getOperAny() {
215    return getSource().operator();
216  }
217
218  /**
219   * The source of the rowset operatorKind that generated the events.
220   * @return
221   */
222  public OperatorKind getKindOperator() {
223    return getSource().operatorKind();
224  }
225
226  /** {@inheritDoc} */
227  @Override
228  public String toString() {
229    return sf("RowsEvent{%d, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s}", gen, objectID(getSource().rowsModel()),
230              objectID(getSource().rowSet()), getSource().operatorKind(),
231              getSource().operator() instanceof RowsAction ? getSource().operator()
232                                                           : objectID(getSource().operator()),
233              rowSetEventTypes);
234  }
235}
